messages:
incident-bot: @channel Incident: Intermittent 502s observed on Hosted API (us-west-2) starting ~14:25 UTC. Classifying P2. Public status: status.redwood.ai/incidents/1797001123 :warning:

ops-oncall: Seeing spikes of 502s from inference-worker timeouts after a config change to the worker thread pool earlier today. Rollback candidate prepared.

emma: Confirmed correlation: deploy of worker-pool-config:v3.6.1 at 13:58 UTC increased per-worker memory pressure -> occasional OOMs and 502s.

jin: Rolling back worker-pool-config to v3.6.0 on a canary subset now. Canaries at 14:40 show 502s dropping.

support-lead: Support: Received 2 customer reports of partial responses. Drafted customer note and queued for publish once ops confirms.

deploy-bot: rollback started by jin:worker-config/v3.6.0 -> canary at 14:40 UTC

ops-oncall: Canary healthy. Proceeding staged rollback across us-west-2 pools with 10m waves. Monitoring token latency and 5xx rates.

emma: Added temporary alert rule to catch rapid rise in worker OOMs and to trigger auto-rollback if threshold exceeded.

jin: Full rollback complete at 14:58 UTC. 502 rate returned to baseline (~0.4%). Leaving monitoring window for 30m.

support-lead: Published customer-facing update: "We've mitigated 502s in us-west-2 by rolling back a recent worker config. Monitoring continuous. Contact support if issues persist." Link: intranet.redwood.ai/cs/1797001123-update

ops-oncall: Current status: mitigated -> monitoring. RCA to follow in 72 hours; initial action items created: tune worker memory limits, add canary checks for config changes, and tighten deploy guard rails.

incident-bot: Status updated: mitigated. Public page: status.redwood.ai/incidents/1797001123 (internal draft: intranet.redwood.ai/incidents/1797001123)

ops-oncall: Closing live thread. Ping me to reopen if we see regressions. :thumbsup:
